summary: Resemble AI's Builder's Grant awards $500–$30,000 in credits (most grants sized to a production-ready proof-of-concept) for detection, Intelligence, watermarking, and Identity APIs, expiring 12 months or less from approval. Voice-generation coverage is not promised by the current program. Open to teams under 50 employees or companies actively building a new product with Resemble detection, watermarking, or identity verification built in. Free-tier users are eligible; existing paid customers are excluded. One application per company; recipients agree to 12 months of marketing collaboration.
claim_steps: Create a free Resemble account at app.resemble.ai.
Confirm eligibility: under 50 employees or actively building a new product with Resemble detection, watermarking, or identity verification; existing paid customers are excluded.
Apply at resemble.ai/start/builders-grant-startup-program describing your project and planned use of detection, Intelligence, watermarking, or Identity APIs; do not assume voice-generation coverage.
Applications are reviewed within one business week; credits land in the account within 48 hours of approval.

social_proof.title: Resemble AI Builder's Grant
social_proof.text: Up to 12 months to build, test, and launch with access to Resemble’s detection, Intelligence, watermarking, and Identity APIs. Grants range from $500 to $30,000, with most builders receiving enough credits to complete a full production-ready proof-of-concept. Credits expire 12 months or less from grant approval.
